arithmetic: exact rational hidden-belief forward recursion and outward integer-square-root sums
theorem: Each length-16 observation cylinder carries exact rational forward beliefs under both HMMs. Outward integer-square-root bounds enclose its Hellinger weight, and summing all 65,536 cylinders encloses Z_16. Combining this finite belief-cylinder certificate with the ST213 quasi-multiplicative constants gives the displayed rigorous asymptotic bracket; its width is log(8)/16, exactly three quarters of the n=12 width.
